name: mentra-channel
description: Sutando as a MentraOS glasses app (full-duplex channel): wake-phrase-gated live transcription becomes broker tasks (source=mentra via /v1/ingest), replies render on the glasses (text wall + TTS) with the broker's Mentra fallback room covering glasses-off delivery.
